**Taylor:** Would you accept a timeboxed spike on PDF export alongside your sprint work? Two half-days to prove out the approach and give us honest Sprint 2 estimates?

**My Commitment:**

I will document these decisions. I will shield this team from mid-sprint scope changes. And if circumstances change, we will face them together with transparency.

The testing—and the planning—will be done with honor.

*meets each person's eyes in turn*

Do I have your agreement to proceed on this basis? Speak now with whatever concerns remain in your hearts.
